name: memova
description: Run Memova workflows and sync opt-in Codex history into the Knowledge V5 Wiki.

interface.shortDescription: Open Knowledge V5 setup, diagnosis, tasks, and legacy vault tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for knowledge-base and automation workflows. Use @memova to review tasks, configure the consent-gated conversation Collector, and maintain the Knowledge V5 Wiki. Version 1.5.1 keeps the neutral raw archive and verified business-source association pass while deterministically preserving every Codex Session title from the integrity-bound Bundle. Existing V2/V3 tools remain available only for the staged transition.
